d:
On April 30, 2022, Bihar Chief Minister Nitish Kumar inaugurated a greenfield grain-based ethanol plant in Parora, Purnia. Eastern India Biofuels Private Limited set up the plant at a cost of ₹105 crore (approximately $1.05 billion). The plant produces ethanol from grain. However, farmers' crops are being destroyed in the process. Toxic water from the plant is damaging crops and soil, and the smoke is making people sick.
Report: Akash Kumar
